evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Clean routing to virtual walkthrough. Rep identified 1900 sq ft triggering walkthrough protocol, offered video call option, and customer declined immediate availability but agreed to send videos tonight. Rep secured phone number, confirmed follow-up process, and set callback for tomorrow after videos are received.

top_strength: Clean walkthrough routing and follow-up process: Jules correctly identified the 1900 sq ft home as requiring a virtual walkthrough instead of a phone estimate, offered a video call, and when the customer couldn't do it immediately, pivoted to accepting uploaded videos tonight with a callback tomorrow—keeping the path to the estimate clear and on track.
coaching_note: Before routing to walkthrough, deliver the Two Promises step (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage with specific terms) and ask the two-concerns question to surface what matters to this customer—this positions you to address their real worries when you follow up tomorrow, not just collect videos.
